targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS blocked_sessions FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'verdict' AND band = 'block' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Sessions over time by initial source
panels.description: Each session is counted once and attributed using its earliest beacon in the selected dashboard range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(first_seen, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS time, source, count() AS sessions FROM (SELECT session_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen, argMin(if(attribution_channel = '', 'unknown', attribution_channel), timestamp) AS source FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' GROUP BY session_id) GROUP BY time, source ORDER BY time

SELECT source, count() AS sessions FROM (SELECT session_id, argMin(if(attribution_channel = '', 'unknown', attribution_channel), timestamp) AS source FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' GROUP BY session_id) GROUP BY source ORDER BY sessions DESC

panels.title: Traffic by source — 7 days / 24 hours / 1 hour

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, countIf(first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS last_7_days, countIf(first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS last_24_hours, countIf(first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS last_hour FROM (SELECT session_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen, argMin(if(attribution_channel = '', 'unknown', attribution_channel), timestamp) AS source FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY session_id) GROUP BY source ORDER BY last_7_days DESC

panels.title: Most visited pages — selected range
panels.description: Unique sessions per path; one session visiting the same page repeatedly counts once.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(landing_path = '', '/', landing_path) AS page, uniqExact(session_id) AS unique_sessions FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' GROUP BY page ORDER BY unique_sessions DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top landing pages — selected range
panels.description: The earliest captured page for each session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT landing_page, count() AS sessions FROM (SELECT session_id, argMin(if(landing_path = '', '/', landing_path), timestamp) AS landing_page FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' GROUP BY session_id) GROUP BY landing_page ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, 'failed beacons' AS metric, count() AS value FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' AND beacon_integrity_ok = 0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, 'blocked sessions' AS metric, uniqExact(session_id) AS value FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'verdict' AND band = 'block' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Search and campaign origins — selected range
panels.description: Search engines normally hide the actual search phrase; document_referrer shows whatever the browser exposes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, referrer_host, utm_campaign, count() AS sessions FROM (SELECT session_id, argMin(if(attribution_channel = '', 'unknown', attribution_channel), timestamp) AS source, argMin(ifNull(domain(document_referrer), ''), timestamp) AS referrer_host, argMin(utm_campaign, timestamp) AS utm_campaign FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' GROUP BY session_id) GROUP BY source, referrer_host, utm_campaign ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT formatDateTime(max(timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S', 'Asia/Dhaka') AS last_seen_bdt, left(session_id, 8) AS session, replaceOne(argMin(toString(ip), timestamp), '::ffff:', '') AS ip, argMinIf(attribution_channel, timestamp, kind = 'beacon' AND attribution_channel != '') AS source, argMinIf(landing_path, timestamp, kind = 'beacon' AND landing_path != '') AS landing, countIf(kind = 'beacon') AS beacons, countIf(kind = 'beacon' AND beacon_integrity_ok = 0) AS integrity_failures, if(countIf(kind = 'verdict') > 0, argMaxIf(band, timestamp, kind = 'verdict'), 'pending') AS verdict FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC LIMIT 40
